full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows a young person bending forward over an indistinct mass of leaves, fragments, and pale scattered material. The figure fills most of the frame. Dark tousled hair falls over the forehead, and the face tilts down toward the hands and the activity below. A light-toned long-sleeved shirt is visible across the shoulders and upper arms, but its front darkens into the shadow at the center. The left arm reaches diagonally toward the lower left corner; the right arm descends toward the lower right, enclosing the bright textured area between them. The hands are partly hidden by the density of the foreground. Small pale flecks streak across the dark shirt and rise from the lower center, suggesting material in motion, although its exact source is not clear. The face is intent and unsmiling, with eyes directed downward. Behind the figure, mottled gray shapes provide a rough, shallow background without a clearly legible setting. The image has coarse film grain and abrupt light-dark shifts. The brightest region lies near the lower center, where crumpled light surfaces and specks contrast with the dark torso. Hair and folded clothing take on broad near-black shapes, while the sleeves and cheek retain intermediate grays. Light appears to come from the upper left, catching the hair, the left sleeve, and some flying pale particles; the area under the face remains shaded. The close view leaves no horizon or open space, making the figure's downward movement and rough surface texture the central experience. No readable text appears. The overall composition is urgent and tactile, with a bent human form nearly merging into an active field of grain, fragments, and shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白照片：一个年轻人俯身靠向一团难以确指的叶片、碎块和散落浅色材料。人物占据画面大部分。深色凌乱头发垂在额前，脸向下倾，望着手和下面正在进行的动作。浅色长袖衬衫横过肩膀和上臂，正面却在中央阴影里转暗。左臂斜向左下角伸出，右臂垂向右下，把两臂之间明亮而有肌理的区域围起来。双手被密集前景部分遮住。细小浅色碎点划过深色衣服，从下方中央向上飞散，暗示某些材料正在运动，但确切来源看不清。面容专注，没有微笑，眼睛朝下。人物身后，斑驳灰色形块构成粗糙而浅的背景，无法清楚辨认具体场所。照片具有粗颗粒和突然变化的明暗。最亮区域靠近下方中央，那里皱折的浅色表面与碎点同深色躯干对照。头发和折叠衣服形成宽阔近黑块面，袖子与脸颊保留中间灰阶。光似乎来自左上，照到头发、左袖和一些飞散的浅色颗粒；面部下方仍处阴影。紧凑视角没有地平线或开阔空间，使俯身动作与粗糙表面质地成为核心感受。画中没有可读文字。整体构图紧迫、可触，弯曲的人体几乎并入活跃的颗粒、碎块和阴影之中。
style_prompt_en: Grainy monochrome photography uses close framing, abrupt tonal patches, and energetic small specks to convey physical immediacy. A dark central mass is crossed by paler diagonal forms, while the brightest fragments gather near the lower part of the frame. Edges are partly obscured by overlapping texture and motion, giving the image a raw documentary character. Coarse grain and rubbed-looking highlights remain visible across both surfaces and air. Directional light catches scattered points but leaves broad areas in deep shadow. The overall effect is urgent and tactile, with a tightly enclosed composition that favors movement and material over polished clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 粗颗粒单色摄影以紧凑画框、突然变化的明度斑块和活跃的小碎点传递直接的身体感。深色中央大块被较浅的斜向形体穿过，最亮碎片聚在画面下部。边缘部分被重叠肌理和运动遮住，让影像具有粗放的纪实气质。粗颗粒和擦亮般的高光同时留在物体表面与空气中。定向光接住散落亮点，却把宽阔区域留在深影里。整体效果紧迫、可触，围合紧密的构图重视运动和材料，而非光洁清晰。
theme_en: A young person bent over scattered material in a grainy monochrome scene
theme_zh: 年轻人在颗粒感黑白画面中俯身于散落材料上
name: Kikuji Kawada
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
